title: data: under a search, a paged list's `total` is a page-local estimate (offset + page + 1), and the console shows it as the record count ("26 records" for 300 matches)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect, class (b) (a seam), found while fixing objectstack-ai/objectui#12081 item 3 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12123) and outside that card's scope. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_01AswpQDLCKiZos2jCXknwKz`) from the dev's measured out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades and routes.

**Reader:** objectstack triage, then the lane that owns `packages/metadata-protocol` (the engine count) with objectui's count bar as the consumer.

## What was measured (on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0, in process through `RestServer`'s route handler)

- `GET /api/v1/data/:object?$top=25&$search=Line` answered `total: 26` while 300 rows match.
- `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` with search `'1'` answered `total: 26`, while the same query unlimited returned 138 rows.
- The console's list then reads "26 records", and its pager offers 2 pages.

## Why (code read on objectstack `main` `e84aeb36c`)

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `findData`'s paged arm:
  - `countable = options.search == null`;
  - a search takes the last branch, `total = pageOffset + records.length + (hasMore ? 1 : 0)`, because the engine count is asked with `where` only and no search.
- The neighbouring comment states the risk itself: "Handing back a plausible-looking guess under those circumstances is how a page-local estimate ends up rendered as a record count."
- `FindDataResponse.total` is declared as "Total number of records matching the filter (if requested)". Nothing on the response marks a `total` as an estimate, so a client cannot tell the two apart.

`Seam: spec:FindDataResponseSchema.total → runtime:metadata-protocol findData (search arm) | renderer:plugin-list ListView record-count bar, plugin-grid ObjectGrid pager`

## Not decided here

Which side changes is for triage:
- count under the search (the engine count takes the search expansion the flat find uses);
- omit `total` under a search, as `$count=false` already does, so the renderer shows no count;
- or declare an estimate marker.

objectui#12123 already refuses to pair a whole-set footer figure with this count: its count check sends the case to the page-labelled figure.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, including closed:
- `findData total under search is page-local estimate engine.count search record count` → 1 hit, #20358 (closed: grouped counts dropped `search`, a different arm);
- `search total wrong count hasMore offset estimate list record count bar search` → 0 hits.

Control: `grouped counts search dropped aggregations` finds #20358, so the channel answers.
